recent_posts.title: Using Frontegg Authentication with Vue.js
recent_posts.summary: Frontegg is a popular authentication service that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers across the globe. It provides all the user management capabilities your B2B SaaS needs, allowing a full self-served experience within your product. It takes just 5 minutes to add a complete authentication and user management to your application. Now we can start authenticating users into our app. We've learned how to integrate Frontegger.

recent_posts.title: Ref vs Reactive
recent_posts.summary: Vue 3’s Composition API provides two main ways of declaring reactive data: ref and reactive. This tutorial will cover the following: ref, reactive and the pros and cons of each. Ref: To create a single reactive variable you can use ref . Reactive: Reactive can only be initialized with an object. The best option is to just use one or the other!

recent_posts.title: Build an Online Course App with Vue
recent_posts.summary: In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to create a single-page app course site using Vue 3 & Vite. The features will include markdown-based content, embedded Vimeo videos, and lesson navigation. At the end of the tutorial, we’re going to integrate CourseKit which is a headless API for hosting online courses.

recent_posts.title: Vue.js + Astro - Better Than A Vue SPA?

recent_posts.title: Vite vs Vue CLI
recent_posts.summary: Vite is a new build tool in the Vue ecosystem. Its dev server is 10-100x faster than Vue's. Does this mean Vue CLI is obsolete? In this article, I'll be comparing the two build tools and addressing the pros and cons.

recent_posts.title: Should You Use Composition API as a Replacement for Vuex?
recent_posts.summary: The Composition API has freed reactive data from Vue components and instances, allowing it to be passed around like any JavaScript object. In this article, I'll show you how you can replace Vuex with features of the Com composition API, and also make the case for whether this is a wise idea or not.

recent_posts.title: Cool Features of Vue Router 4
recent_posts.summary: Vue Router 4 is currently in beta. Vue 3 has introduced the createApp API which changes the way plugins are added to a Vue instance. The new createRouter API creates an instance of the router that is installable with Vue3. Dynamic routing will allow you to add routes while the router is running. Navigation guards can return value instead of next.
